name: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable of the common species. They range widely in appearance and temperament, and their ambition drives them into every corner of the world.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

name: Elf
summary: Long-lived, keen-sensed, and touched by the Feywild.
description: Elves are magical people of otherworldly grace, whose ancestors dwelled in the Feywild. Their bonds with that plane leave them with heightened senses and a trance-like rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: You are part of an elven lineage that grants you supernatural abilities.

lineages.name: Drow
lineages.description: The elves of the Underdark. Your Darkvision has a range of 120 feet, and you know the Dancing Lights cantrip.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet.

lineages.name: High Elf
lineages.description: Heirs of arcane tradition. You know the Prestidigitation cantrip and can swap it whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Arcane Cantrip
traits.description: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace it with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

lineages.name: Wood Elf
lineages.description: Swift keepers of the wild. Your Speed increases to 35 feet and you know the Druidcraft cantrip.
